name: E-Commerce Specialist Returns & Refunds Agent
description: Specialised domain agent responsible for calculating return eligibility, issuing Return Merchandise Authorisations (RMAs), generating return shipping labels, and authorising refunds.

capabilities.name: Return Eligibility & Refund Valuation
capabilities.description: Evaluates return window compliance (e.g. 30 days), item condition rules, and calculates itemised refund amounts in GBP (£).

capabilities.name: RMA & Shipping Label Creation
capabilities.description: Generates unique RMA tracking codes and secure download URLs for return shipping labels.
